title: Perseverance Sets the Off-World Driving Record (Oct. 11, 2026)
description:
On Oct. 11, 2026, NASA's Perseverance rover passed 28.10 miles (45.22 km), beating the record of 28.06 miles (45.16 km) set by Opportunity. Opportunity needed almost 15 years to drive that far; Perseverance took five and a half. It drives itself with AutoNav: where Sojourner checked 20 points ahead, Perseverance processes 600,000 with every look. Next stop: Idubi, to look for traces of ancient hot water systems.
